reviews.summary: Identified the patch as a valid workaround for TLBI Erratum #1718, but noted that it's not the most proper solution and suggested updating microcode instead.

2026-10-03.patch_summary: Fix for AMD TLBI Erratum #1718, a workaround to prevent TLB shootdowns.

reviews.author: Borislav Petkov
reviews.summary: Confirmed that the patch is a valid workaround, but emphasized that updating microcode is still the preferred solution and expressed plans to queue the patch for 7.3.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri, Oct 02, 2026 at 08:31:30PM -0400, Rik van Riel wrote:
> This same change fell out of my testing with
> a reproducer earlier this year, so I know it
> works, at least for the test case I have.
> 
> I am surprised that it was good enough to be 
> a real workaround, but I'll take it ;)

Me too, but it really is - there's a good reason why :)

But the most proper workaround is for everyone to update microcode anyway - it
is released too, so we don't even need the sw fallback.

> Tested-by: Rik van Riel <riel@surriel.com>
> Reviewed-by: Rik van Riel <riel@surriel.com>

Thanks, my plan is to queue it next week so that we have it in 7.3 and it
percolates to stable.

-- 
Regards/Gruss,
    Boris.

https://people.kernel.org/tglx/notes-about-netiquette
